Cohesive light UI, warm off-white background, strong visual hierarchy, restrained accent color. Main product content large enough to understand at thumbnail size, minimal text. Include small subtle label 'PROJECT PREVIEW'. No Karma42 dashboard, no agent metrics, no claims of a finished product. Pocket Garden: an actual playable cozy 2D browser gardening game screen. Friendly charming pixel-inspired illustrated game assets, clear game controls, green accents. The game board is the focus, not mascot characters or abstract garden scenery.
